registration_note: Written before this detailed diagnostic; previously published negative ALL summaries were already known. This is a retrospective decision rubric, not a prospective strategy preregistration.
money: Decimal, scenario USD, closed and known partial only

decisions.STOP: Both fixed costs have negative known-partial net AND negative sum of fully resolved segment net AND closed profit factor below 1. Stop promotion of this unchanged FF configuration; no claim that all future strategy variants are disproved.
decisions.CANDIDATE_FOR_FRESH_TEST: Both costs have positive known-partial net AND positive fully resolved segment net AND closed profit factor above 1 AND no unresolved positions. Only eligibility for a new prospectively specified test, never market approval.
decisions.RESEARCH_ONLY: All other cases, or required evidence unmeasurable.

bounds: NOT_BOUNDED for any unresolved exposure; no invented execution/quote/swap cap
signal_features: Only family, lookback, stop_multiple, side and observed holding/initial risk derived from recorded fields. ATR/ADX/regime/actual bid-ask and spread/slippage cash components absent in trace are UNMEASURABLE.
cost_comparison: Descriptive scenario differences, with entry-matched cohorts; never interpret difference in aggregate net as pure friction when paths differ.
